about: Elsible's deck v4 (3 Oct 2026): normal life first, the researched tropes face up and dealt first. The hidden half is the twist the weave writes for this trope, this life: each trope card carries the weave's guide (signals, if nobody intervenes, if somebody does).

slots.label: THE OTHER
slots.hint: how they treat you · always fictional

slots.label: UNDERNEATH
slots.hint: internal: the weave's reference, never dealt

trope.name: Enemies to lovers
trope.line: You need the person you came here to beat

signals: they defend something you care about when you're not there to see it
the grudge turns out to have a second side
your own side asks you to do something that would hurt them
you're relieved when they win something small
if_nobody_intervenes: you meet across the table at the decisive moment, still enemies, and it hurts
your side wins, and you're the one who has to tell them
hidden.if_somebody_does: you choose them over your own side, and pay for it in public

signals: a rule of the arrangement gets broken and nobody mentions it
someone outside the arrangement believes it completely
a gesture that wasn't for show
the end date gets mentioned, and nobody laughs
if_nobody_intervenes: the arrangement ends on schedule, and only one of you meant it
it's exposed as fake in front of the people it was for
hidden.if_somebody_does: the arrangement is ended early, honestly, and what's left is real or nothing

trope.name: Second chance
trope.line: The one that got away is back in town
trope.changes: The old wound is a fact from day one

signals: the old wound gets named, lightly, by someone else
they still do the small thing they used to do
the reason they left was not the reason you were told
an old friend chooses a side
if_nobody_intervenes: the same mistake, made again, in the same place
they leave again, and this time you watch it happen
hidden.if_somebody_does: the real reason is said out loud, and you decide what it changes

trope.name: Friends to lovers
trope.line: The best thing in your life, and you might break it

signals: someone else wants them, and says so
a joke between you that lands differently this time
a friend asks a question you answer too fast
you notice where they sit when they come into a room
if_nobody_intervenes: someone else gets there first, and the friendship survives, worse
it's said by accident, at the worst time, and can't be taken back
hidden.if_somebody_does: one of you says it deliberately, and the friendship becomes whatever comes next

trope.name: Marriage of convenience
trope.line: On paper it's practical. That's the deal

signals: a kindness the contract didn't ask for
someone asks how long it's meant to last
the terms get broken in a small way, and it feels like a gift
leaving becomes possible
if_nobody_intervenes: the contract runs out and both of you sign the end
partners in everything except the one thing
hidden.if_somebody_does: someone stays when the contract says they're free to go, and says why

trope.name: Forbidden love
trope.line: There's a rule, and it has teeth
trope.changes: Every meeting is a risk someone can see

signals: the rule gets enforced on somebody else, and it's brutal
a meeting that nobody was supposed to see
someone who could report it chooses not to, for now
the barrier turns out to have a price
if_nobody_intervenes: it's discovered, by the worst possible person
one of you gives it up quietly to protect the other
hidden.if_somebody_does: it goes public on purpose, and the rule has to answer

trope.name: Betrayal
trope.changes: Trust is built where you can see it

signals: trust built where everyone can see it
a small lie, explained away well
something of yours ends up where it shouldn't be
someone else warns you, and you don't believe them
if_nobody_intervenes: the betrayal lands, and you're the last to know
you find out, and they never learn that you did
hidden.if_somebody_does: it's caught before it lands, and you decide what they're owed

trope.name: The impostor
trope.line: You were pretending until it mattered
trope.changes: They fall for the person, not the mask

signals: someone uses a name that isn't quite yours
a detail from the life you claimed doesn't fit
they start loving the person under the mask
someone from the real past arrives
if_nobody_intervenes: the mask comes off in public, not by your choice
the mask becomes the person, and the old one is gone
hidden.if_somebody_does: you take the mask off yourself, to the one person who matters

trope.name: The long con
trope.changes: The con only works if you mean it

signals: the plan needs one more favour than planned
the mark does something kind that makes it harder
a partner in the plan gets impatient
you start to mean what you say to them
if_nobody_intervenes: the score lands, and you lose the mark
the con collapses and takes both of you down
hidden.if_somebody_does: you choose: the score or the mark, out loud, to one of them

signals: both sides ask for proof in the same week
the people you report on start to trust you
a message from your handler arrives at a bad moment
someone else is also lying, and you can tell
if_nobody_intervenes: you're caught, by the side you came to love
you stay inside both sides until it costs someone you care about
hidden.if_somebody_does: you burn one side yourself, and choose which

trope.name: Rise and fall
trope.line: You want it, and you'll get it
trope.changes: Getting it costs something you didn't price

signals: you get something you wanted, and it costs more than you priced
an old friend stops calling
the people above you start treating you as one of them
you hear yourself say something the old you would hate
if_nobody_intervenes: you reach the top, and there's nobody there you like
you fall, in public, and find out who stayed
hidden.if_somebody_does: you walk away from it, or refuse it, before it finishes you

signals: a rescue nobody asked for
someone from your old life wants you back
a meal that becomes a tradition
one of them is in trouble and doesn't tell you
if_nobody_intervenes: the group scatters, and nobody chose it
one of them is lost, and the rest hold
hidden.if_somebody_does: you choose them over blood or the old life, out loud

trope.name: Mixing business and pleasure
trope.line: It was work, until it wasn't
trope.changes: The job and the feeling want different endings

signals: they remember a detail from a meeting you thought was only business
a message that arrives after hours and isn't about the work
someone in the room notices how you two talk
the paperwork asks a question you don't want to answer honestly
if_nobody_intervenes: the deal closes and the feeling is never said
it comes out at the worst possible meeting, in front of everyone
hidden.if_somebody_does: the job and the feeling are separated, and one of them is given up on purpose

trope.name: The file on them
trope.line: You were looking into them. You kept looking
trope.changes: Every fact you find is also a reason to like them

signals: the record has a gap, and the gap is interesting
someone who knew them before talks too warmly, or too carefully
you catch yourself looking for reasons to keep looking
they mention something you only know because you were looking
if_nobody_intervenes: they find out you were looking, from someone else
you close the file, and know more than you can ever admit
hidden.if_somebody_does: you tell them what you were doing before anyone else can

role.name: The new hire
role.line: First week, and everyone already has a version of you
role.changes: Names before loyalties · first impressions stick
role.conflict: who you'll turn into to fit in

role.name: The one who came back
role.line: You left town. Now you're home
role.changes: Everyone remembers a version of you
role.conflict: the old you is still here

role.name: The best friend
role.line: Always the confidant, never the lead
role.changes: You know everyone's secrets but your own

role.name: The single parent
role.line: Someone small depends on you completely
role.conflict: guilt every time you take it

role.name: The bridesmaid
role.changes: Always in the photos, never the point of them
role.want: to stop being the plus-one in your own life

role.name: The bodyguard
role.line: Paid to stand close and see nothing
role.changes: You hear everything and can say nothing
role.want: to do the job and go home
role.conflict: it stopped being just a job

role.name: The assistant
role.line: In every room, and nobody sees you
role.changes: Power is borrowed, and you know where it lives

role.name: The heir to the family business
role.line: It's yours, and you didn't want it
role.changes: Every choice is also about the family

role.name: The night-shift nurse
role.line: You see people at their worst, at 3am
role.changes: Calm in a crisis, a mess in daylight
role.want: someone to look after you for once
role.conflict: you don't know how to be looked after

role.name: The influencer
role.line: Your life is public, and it's not quite true
role.changes: Everything is content until it isn't
role.conflict: the real thing would end the brand

role.name: The ghostwriter
role.line: You write other people's lives for a living
role.changes: You notice the gaps in people's stories

role.name: The detective
role.line: It's your job to find out
role.changes: You can ask anyone anything, and they know why
role.conflict: what the truth will cost someone you like

role.name: The one who woke up somewhere else
role.line: You opened your eyes in someone else's life
role.changes: Everyone expects you to know them
role.conflict: you're starting to like it here

world.name: The office
world.line: Open plan, glass walls, one kitchen
world.changes: Everyone sees who talks to who

world.name: The small town
world.line: You can't buy milk without being asked about it

world.name: College
world.line: Four years, one campus, everyone deciding who they are
world.changes: Rooms are shared, drama is public

world.name: The apartment building
world.line: Thin walls, one laundry room, forty neighbours
world.changes: You know their routines; they know yours

world.name: The wedding weekend
world.line: Three days, one venue, everyone you know

world.name: The lake house
world.line: One summer, one house, too many people
world.changes: Nobody can leave, nobody wants to

world.name: The hospital
world.line: Long shifts, high stakes, a coffee machine that's always broken

world.name: The tour
world.line: A band, a bus, forty cities in sixty days

world.name: The reality show
world.line: Cameras everywhere, and a vote on Sunday

world.name: The family restaurant
world.line: Three generations, one kitchen, a lot of shouting
world.changes: Business and family are the same argument

world.name: The city at night
world.changes: Help and harm are one street apart

world.name: Another world
world.line: A world that isn't yours, that seems to know you
world.changes: Nothing works the way you expect

world.name: The old house
world.line: It's been in the family a long time. So has something else

other.name: The one who doesn't know
other.line: They have no idea what you are to them
other.changes: Deflects praise · every confession is unprompted

other.name: The one who tests you
other.changes: They only move on honest answers

other.name: The one who knows your secret
other.line: They could ruin you, and they haven't

other.name: The one who's already decided about you
other.line: Sure of you, one way or the other
other.changes: Changing their mind takes something big

other.name: The one who believes in you
The one who left
other.line: They had a reason, and never said it
other.changes: It starts cold and the wound is real

other.name: The boss
other.changes: Every kindness is also a power move

other.name: The rival
other.line: Only one of you gets it

other.name: Grumpy to your sunshine
other.line: They're rude to everyone. Slightly less to you
other.changes: Warmth comes in small, rare doses

other.name: The one everyone warned you about
other.changes: Every kindness looks like a trick

other.name: The one who needs you
other.line: They can't do this alone, and they hate that
other.changes: Helping costs you something every time

other.name: The one who remembers you differently
other.line: They knew you before, and you don't remember it
other.changes: Every memory they share is a test

circle.name: The friend who saw it first
The other one who wants them
circle.changes: Their chances rise when yours stall

circle.name: The one with the rule
circle.changes: A rule you'll break, and they'll notice

circle.name: The committee in your head
circle.changes: They argue out loud · one may act on impulse

circle.name: The confidant
circle.line: Someone you tell everything, drafts included
circle.changes: Draft with them, send to the Other

circle.name: The ex
circle.line: Still around, still kind, still a problem
circle.changes: A history the Other will hear about

circle.name: The kid
circle.changes: Says the true thing in front of everyone

circle.name: The old friend
circle.changes: Remembers who you were, and says so

circle.name: The sibling
circle.line: Shares your history and your blame
circle.changes: On your side, until they aren't

circle.name: The roommate
circle.line: Knows when you came home, and who with

circle.name: The parent who calls every day
The dog
circle.changes: Knows who to trust before you do

told_by.name: Your best friend, telling it later
told_by.changes: Warm, teasing, knows how it ends · never takes your side completely

told_by.name: The gossip column
told_by.changes: Names, scandal, exclamation · never misses a look

told_by.name: The true-crime podcast
told_by.changes: Timestamps and evidence · never says who did it too early

told_by.name: Your diary
told_by.changes: Honest, embarrassing, private · never edits itself

told_by.name: The rom-com narrator
told_by.changes: Sees the meet-cute coming · never lets you miss a beat

told_by.name: The nature documentary
told_by.changes: Describes you like a rare animal · never interferes

told_by.name: The noir detective
told_by.changes: Short, hard sentences · never trusts anyone

told_by.name: The campfire story
told_by.changes: Builds dread slowly · never explains the noise

told_by.name: The wedding toast
told_by.changes: Tells the embarrassing parts on purpose · never finishes a tangent

told_by.name: The group chat transcript
told_by.changes: Everyone talking at once · never in the right order

modifier.name: Slow burn
modifier.changes: Tension rises slower · the point of no return stays locked longer

modifier.name: Hurt / comfort
modifier.changes: A hidden hurt, a tending scene, and a telling

modifier.name: Forced proximity
modifier.line: Stuck together. One room. One bed

modifier.name: A ticking clock
modifier.line: The time left is always in view

modifier.name: A comedy of errors
modifier.line: Everything goes wrong in the funniest order

modifier.name: Everyone's lying a little
modifier.changes: Every fact starts as a rumour

modifier.name: A love triangle
modifier.line: There's a third person, and they're not wrong

pressure.name: The deadline
pressure.changes: The days are counted out loud

pressure.name: The plus-one
pressure.line: You need a date by Saturday

pressure.name: The promotion
pressure.line: Only one of you gets it
pressure.changes: Every conversation is also a pitch

pressure.name: The screenshot
pressure.line: It's already in the group chat
pressure.changes: The clock runs on the gossip, not on you

pressure.name: The inheritance
pressure.line: The will is read on Friday
pressure.changes: Everyone wants something, including from you

pressure.name: The power cut
pressure.line: Nobody leaves until the lights come back

pressure.name: The visitor
pressure.line: Someone arrived who knows the truth about you

pressure.name: The disappearance
pressure.line: Someone's gone, and you were the last to see them
pressure.changes: Everyone has a theory, including about you

pressure.name: The wrong text
pressure.line: You sent it to the wrong person
pressure.changes: Now they know, and they haven't said

pressure.name: The move
pressure.line: One of you is leaving in a month

pressure.name: The reunion
pressure.line: Ten years, one room, everyone you used to be
pressure.changes: Old versions of you walk in the door

pressure.name: The funeral
pressure.line: Everyone in black, saying what they shouldn't

secret.name: Reporting back
secret.line: Someone close is telling someone else
secret.changes: A friendship is the one that breaks

secret.name: They did it
secret.line: The thing everyone's looking for, they did
secret.changes: Every kindness from them is also cover

secret.name: You started it
secret.line: The trouble began with you, and nobody knows
secret.changes: Being found out is the point of no return

secret.name: The family tie
secret.line: You're related, and nobody's said so

secret.name: The money
secret.line: Someone here is broke, or owes, and is hiding it
secret.changes: Every generous gesture is a bluff

secret.name: Not much time
secret.line: Someone here is running out of it
secret.changes: Every scene with them might be the last

secret.name: Nothing
secret.changes: You're the one expected to break
